# Vijay Kodam

> Personal site of Vijay Kumar Kodam, Principal Engineer in Cloud Technology at Nokia in Helsinki, Finland, AWS Community Builder for 2025 and 2026, and author of the Substack newsletter Notes on Kubernetes, AWS and agentic AI. Practical writing on cloud platforms, AI agents, coding tools, and local LLM inference, alongside projects and conference talks.

Vijay designs and operates production AWS and Kubernetes platforms, including a private 5G platform spanning five regions across three continents. His writing combines production experience with hands-on experiments in AI systems and software development.

Projects document the progression of AI-assisted coding since August 2024, with build dates and tools recorded on the project cards. They include browser applications, games, and developer tools.

Articles in the co-authored section were written with AI assistance: Vijay provided direction, context, and review. Technical observations reflect the versions and conditions at publication time. Views expressed are his own and do not represent his employer.

## Explore the site

- [Blog](https://vijay.eu/posts/): Regular and AI-co-authored articles, newest first.
- [AI Lab](https://vijay.eu/ai-lab/): AI experiments and technical posts selected from the blog.
- [Projects](https://vijay.eu/projects/): A chronological record of what AI coding tools could build, from early experiments to recent applications.
- [Speaking](https://vijay.eu/speaking/): Conference talks and meetups, with slides, recordings, and related resources where available.
- [About](https://vijay.eu/about/): Professional background, focus areas, certifications, and community involvement.
- [Latest](https://vijay.eu/latest/): Combined chronological feed of blog posts, AI-co-authored articles, and projects.

## Recent writing

- [Catch silent model downgrades in Claude Code](https://vijay.eu/posts/model-audit-skill/): Published 2026-07-04. Introducing model-audit, a local transcript audit that reports model IDs for main sessions and subagents.
- [Ornith 35B: testing a self-improving coding model on a Mac Mini M4 Pro](https://vijay.eu/posts/ornith-self-scaffolding-llm/): Published 2026-06-30. Hands-on experience with Ollama and Claude Code, including context-window limits, memory use, and task performance.
- [API Gateway vs Gateway API](https://vijay.eu/posts/api-gw-vs-gw-api/): Published 2026-01-09. Explaining the distinction between an API gateway and Kubernetes Gateway API, with a comparison diagram.
- [2025 Year in Review](https://vijay.eu/posts/2025-year-in-review/): Published 2025-12-30. Reflections on building agents and MCP servers, speaking at conferences, community participation, and AI learning.

## AWS, Kubernetes, and EKS

- [Amazon EKS Capabilities](https://vijay.eu/posts/eks-capabilities/): Published 2025-12-01. Managed Argo CD, ACK, and kro, with discussion of operational benefits, customization limits, and cost trade-offs.
- [First Impressions of EKS Auto Mode](https://vijay.eu/posts/eks-auto-first-impressions/): Published 2024-12-04. Initial experience with EKS Auto Mode and its approach to node management.
- [EKS Auto Mode's 21-day maximum node lifetime](https://vijay.eu/posts/eks-auto-max-node-lifetime/): Published 2024-12-12. Understanding enforced node replacement when planning workload operations.
- [Surprising side effect of running EKS Auto Mode](https://vijay.eu/posts/surprising-side-effect-eks-auto/): Published 2025-01-21. An operational observation from adopting EKS Auto Mode.
- [Pod Disruption Budget vs NodePool Disruption Budget](https://vijay.eu/posts/pod-disruption-budget-vs-nodepool-disruption-budget/): Published 2025-03-02. Comparing Kubernetes pod disruption controls with Karpenter node disruption controls.
- [ARC Zonal Shift in EKS](https://vijay.eu/posts/eks-arc-zonal-shift/): Published 2024-12-30. An introduction to zonal shift for EKS availability.
- [How to get into AWS Community Builders Program](https://vijay.eu/posts/how-to-get-into-aws-community-builders/): Published 2025-05-23. An overview of the program and application advice drawn from Vijay's experience joining in 2025.
- [Fastest and Cheapest Ways to Delete Millions of Files from Amazon S3](https://vijay.eu/posts/s3-delete-millions-of-files/): Published 2024-10-14. Comparing bulk object deletion approaches, including CLI tools, s5cmd, and lifecycle policies, with speed and cost considerations.
- [Where Should I Deploy My K8s Cluster?](https://vijay.eu/posts/deploy-k8s/): Published 2020-05-17. Comparing on-premises, hybrid cloud, self-managed, managed, and local Kubernetes deployment options available at the time.
- [How to login securely to your Amazon EC2 Instance?](https://vijay.eu/posts/how-to-login-securely-to-amazon-ec2/): Published 2020-05-12. Discussing SSH access, bastion hosts, and AWS Systems Manager Session Manager for accessing EC2 instances.

## AI agents, MCP, and inference

- [Deploying LLMs on Amazon EKS using NVIDIA GPUs](https://vijay.eu/posts/deploying-llm-on-eks-and-nvidia-gpu/): Published 2025-05-11. Workshop experience deploying Mistral 7B with Ray Serve, vLLM, KubeRay, Open WebUI, and GPU monitoring.
- [Built my first MCP Server for Kubernetes](https://vijay.eu/posts/building-my-first-mcp-server/): Published 2025-05-14. Building a read-only Kubernetes server for the Model Context Protocol.
- [Built an AI Agent using Strands Agents SDK](https://vijay.eu/posts/built-an-ai-agent/): Published 2025-07-07. Combining an AI agent with MCP to investigate Kubernetes issues.
- [First impressions of the official EKS MCP Server](https://vijay.eu/posts/official-eks-mcp-server/): Published 2025-05-30. Hands-on observations of AWS's EKS MCP tooling.
- [Generate AWS architecture diagrams using MCP and Amazon Q CLI](https://vijay.eu/posts/mcp-amazon-q-cli/): Published 2025-05-04. Using MCP tools and a coding assistant to generate architecture diagrams.
- [My Capstone project for Google GenAI course](https://vijay.eu/posts/google-genai-capstone-project/): Published 2025-04-19. Building a vegetarian recipe agent with LangGraph and Gemini, using few-shot prompting and structured tool outputs.
- [Creating decibel meter using Claude Code Agentic tool](https://vijay.eu/posts/decibel-meter-using-claude-code/): Published 2025-03-13. An early hands-on account of building a browser-based decibel meter with Claude Code for child-friendly voice-level guidance.
- [MLOps 101](https://vijay.eu/posts/mlops-101/): Published 2025-03-04. An introduction to the machine learning lifecycle, covering data management, model development, deployment, and monitoring.
- [Classic Snake Game using LLMs](https://vijay.eu/posts/snake-game/): Published 2025-02-16. Comparing the effort of building a Snake game with Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT, and reflecting on progress since the author's August 2024 experiments.

## Articles co-authored with AI

- [Monitoring Claude Code with Apple Containers Instead of Docker](https://vijay.eu/co-authored/claude-code-monitoring-apple-containers/): Published 2026-02-20. A local Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry setup, with resource comparisons against Docker Desktop.
- [I Ran an 80B Coding Model Locally with Claude Code](https://vijay.eu/co-authored/80b-coding-model-locally-claude-code-ollama/): Published 2026-02-14. Investigating a slow Claude Code and Ollama setup and the bottlenecks in local inference.
- [LLM Inference Internals: KV Cache, Flash Attention, and Optimizing for Apple Silicon](https://vijay.eu/co-authored/llm-inference-internals-apple-silicon/): Published 2026-02-14. Explaining inference mechanics, memory requirements, and tuning considerations.

## Selected projects

- [model-audit](https://vijay.eu/projects/model-audit/): July 2026. A Claude Code skill and plugin that reports model IDs recorded in local session transcripts.
- [Retro Racer](https://vijay.eu/projects/retro-racer/): June 2026. A browser-based 3D racing game with traffic, real car models, and timed laps.
- [Tesla Wrap Maker](https://vijay.eu/projects/tesla-wrap/): May 2026. Design Tesla wraps, export PNGs for Paint Shop, and preview supported models in 3D.
- [Note Quest](https://vijay.eu/projects/note-quest/): February 2026. A music-reading quiz for learning notes on the grand staff, with ten difficulty levels.
- [Hand-Gesture 3D Car Viewer](https://vijay.eu/projects/car-concept/): January 2026. Rotate, move, and zoom a 3D car using hand tracking.
- [Hand-Gesture Cricket](https://vijay.eu/projects/cricket-bowling/): January 2026. A webcam-controlled 3D cricket bowling game.
- [Decibel Meter](https://vijay.eu/projects/decibel-meter/): March 2025. A microphone-based sound-level tool with audio processing in the browser.
- [Classic Snake Game](https://vijay.eu/projects/snake-game/): February 2025. A browser game from the site's earlier AI coding experiments.
- [Flag Game](https://vijay.eu/projects/flag-game/): August 2024. A country-flag quiz from the beginning of the project chronology.

## Selected talks

- [skill-up: How to Make Claude Work Your Way](https://vijay.eu/speaking/claude-code-meetup-helsinki-2026/): Claude Code Meetup Helsinki, March 2026. Agent Skills, their relationship to MCP, hooks, and plugins, and a live slide-generation demo.
- [From Prompt to Deployment in EKS](https://vijay.eu/speaking/aws-community-day-nordics-2025/): AWS Community Day Nordics, October 2025. A live deployment workflow using Amazon Q CLI and MCP servers.
- [AI Agents for Kubernetes Ops: Live incident recovery with MCP](https://vijay.eu/speaking/agentcon-helsinki-2025/): Microsoft AgentCon Helsinki, October 2025. Investigating an EKS incident and delivering a proposed fix through Argo CD.
- [Autonomous Troubleshooting on Amazon EKS with Strands Agents and MCP](https://vijay.eu/speaking/aws-summit-zurich-2025/): AWS Summit Zurich, September 2025. An end-to-end Kubernetes troubleshooting demonstration.
